comparison.objective: Select and place nail plates on studs whose holes violate a depth rule, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual measurement, rule-based selection, plate alignment, flat placement, and release versus tool insertion, counterholding, fine adjustment, locking, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Plate every and only stud with hole edge under 31.75 mm from the face, centered and flat, then release versus two safe carriage stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: This tests measurement-driven protective placement, not adjustable machine dynamics. No spec versions are present; centering and flatness tolerances are not quantified in the body.
